methodology.ordering_policy: Seeded pseudorandom interleaving; each recorded list is the order attempted in one measured round.

selector_evaluation.split_policy: deterministic random one-third configuration-level holdout (split seed 20261011; all seeds for one configuration stay in one partition)
selector_evaluation.interpretation: Regret is selected median latency divided by the fastest measured valid latency for that held-out workload, minus one. Results describe this CPU experiment set only; they do not establish generalisation to other CPUs or accelerators.

limitations: Synthetic generated workloads only; no imported real-world traces.
Portable CPU/NumPy only; no Quadric, GPU, accelerator, or simulator claims.
Single machine and one run session; timings are environment-specific.
The Python reference is a correctness oracle, not a competitive performance baseline.
Selector evaluation has a small held-out set and should be treated as exploratory.
